# Unit 5: The Stack and Function Calls

Compose two real assembly calls while preserving the caller's state. This replaces the earlier opening leaf arithmetic exercise with a stack-frame task. The later C interop project adds a separate five-to-three argument mapping and clamp contract; this project focuses on two nested assembly calls and their stack lifetime.

## Target, files and learner task

Use Linux x86-64, System V AMD64, GNU/Clang Intel syntax, CMake 3.20 or later, Clang or GCC, GDB and objdump. Use an x86-64 Linux VM or lab on macOS, or an x86-64 WSL distribution on Windows. Each role builds independently with `routine.S`, `stack.h`, `main.c`, `tests.c`, `abi_checks.S` and `CMakeLists.txt`.

Complete only `STACK_CALLS` in `starter/routine.S`. The supplied `stack_leaf` remains unchanged. Record a stack diagram before editing. Save the learner attempt before comparing the separate reference.

## Exact two-call contract

```c
int64_t stack_leaf(int64_t input);
int64_t stack_pair(int64_t a, int64_t b);
```

Every signed 64-bit input is valid. The leaf returns the signed interpretation of the low 64 bits of `2 * input + 5`. The pair routine calls that leaf first for a and then for b, exactly once each, and adds the two returned bit patterns modulo 2^64. Thus the final result is the signed interpretation of the low 64 bits of `2*a + 2*b + 10`. C tests use unsigned arithmetic and copy the bits into `int64_t`; signed C overflow is not part of the contract.

The pair receives a in RDI and b in RSI and returns its result in RAX. Before each call to the leaf, move that call's input into RDI. The leaf may change RDI, RSI, RDX, RCX and R8 through R11. Its supplied implementation deliberately clears those caller-saved registers after computing RAX. Holding b or the first result in one of those registers across a call is incorrect.

Preserve RBX, RBP and R12 through R15, the stack pointer and return address. If a preserved register holds temporary state, save its incoming value before changing it and restore it before return. Keeping the numeric answer while skipping or substituting the two calls is incomplete: the native probe checks actual call count and ordered inputs.

## Stack lifetime and alignment

At the pair entry, RSP is 8 modulo 16 because its caller pushed an eight-byte return address. Before either nested call, RSP must be 0 modulo 16. The leaf then enters at 8 modulo 16. Both calls must observe this entry alignment.

One possible frame saves two eight-byte registers and reserves another eight bytes. The total 24-byte adjustment turns an entry remainder of 8 into a call-site remainder of 0. After both calls, undo the reservation and restore the saved registers in reverse order. Another valid frame can save three registers. Explain each push, subtraction, call, return, addition and pop with the actual address and stack remainder.

For a=3 and b=7, the first leaf returns 11 and the second returns 19. Keep b live while the first call clears RSI and keep 11 live while the second call replaces RAX. Return 30 after restoring the original frame.

| Point | RSP remainder mod 16 | Live values |
| --- | --- | --- |
| pair entry | 8 | a in RDI, b in RSI |
| after a balanced 24-byte frame | 0 | saved b, saved caller registers |
| first leaf entry | 8 | input 3; return address points into pair |
| after first leaf return | 0 | result 11 must remain live |
| second leaf entry | 8 | input 7; earlier result saved |
| after second leaf return | 0 | results 11 and 19 |
| pair return | 8 | original caller registers and return address restored |

## Build, complete and test

From the project folder:

```sh
cmake -S starter -B build-starter -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang -DCMAKE_ASM_COMPILER=clang
cmake --build build-starter
ctest --test-dir build-starter --output-on-failure
./build-starter/assembly_stack
```

The untouched starter builds, fails its contracts and exits 78 with an unfinished-task message on stderr and no successful rows. After a correct frame and two calls, the demo prints:

```text
a=3 b=7 result=30
a=-5 b=19 result=38
a=9223372036854775807 b=1 result=10
a=-9223372036854775808 b=-1 result=8
```

Build the reference with `-S solution -B build-solution`. Repeat completed learner and reference in separate Release folders. For GCC set both compiler options to `gcc`.

Each healthy profile checks 10,012 fixed and deterministic full-width pairs, six preserved registers, two actual leaf invocations, ordered arguments and both leaf-entry alignments. The instrumented test leaf runs the same arithmetic and register-clobbering instructions as the production leaf, adding only observation of its call boundary. A separate arbitrary-precision Python oracle verifies the full-width results. The ordinary demo does not link the observer globals.

## Debugger trace of the actual nested call

```sh
objdump -d -M intel build-solution/assembly_stack
gdb ./build-solution/assembly_stack
```

At the GDB prompt:

```text
set disassembly-flavor intel
tbreak *stack_leaf
run
info registers rdi rsi rax rsp
print ((unsigned long)$rsp & 15)
x/gx $rsp
finish
print $rax
continue
```

The first leaf receives 3, has an entry remainder of 8 and returns 11. Its saved return address points back into stack_pair. For a longer trace, start at stack_pair, use `si` through the frame and both calls, and record the restored RBX/R12 values and final RAX=30. Record observed addresses instead of assuming a fixed layout.

## Completion evidence and independent practice

1. Record the two-call pseudocode, register lifetime table and balanced stack diagram.
2. Complete only the pair body and pass Debug/Release with Clang/GCC.
3. Predict and record the four default rows and at least one changed full-width pair.
4. Trace both nested calls and show their ordered arguments, entry alignment, return values and final frame restoration.
5. Explain why holding b in RSI or the first result in RAX across the next call loses information, and why returning the formula without invoking the leaf misses the task.

Independent study follows prediction, frame sketch, edit, contract tests and instruction tracing. A guided walkthrough follows the same evidence and diagnoses the first failed boundary check. An optional extension can use a different balanced frame after the required contract passes; the leaf, call order and inputs remain unchanged.

## References

- [System V x86-64 ABI project](https://gitlab.com/x86-psABIs/x86-64-ABI)
- [GNU assembler Intel syntax](https://sourceware.org/binutils/docs/as/i386_002dVariations.html)
- [GDB instruction stepping](https://sourceware.org/gdb/current/onlinedocs/gdb.html/Continuing-and-Stepping.html)

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(assembly_stack LANGUAGES C ASM)
if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux" OR NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(x86_64|AMD64)$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Use Linux x86-64 System V.")
endif()
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
add_library(stack STATIC routine.S)
add_executable(assembly_stack main.c)
target_link_libraries(assembly_stack PRIVATE stack)
add_executable(stack_contracts tests.c abi_checks.S routine.S)
target_compile_definitions(stack_contracts PRIVATE STACK_TEST_PROBE)
foreach(target assembly_stack stack_contracts)
    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wconversion -Werror)
endforeach()
include(CTest)
add_test(NAME stack_contracts COMMAND stack_contracts)

"""Verify the nested assembly calls and the balanced stack-frame contract."""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PACK = ROOT / "ASM-07-unit-5-the-stack-and-function-calls"
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--cc", choices=["clang", "gcc"], required=True)
parser.add_argument("--skip-debugger", action="store_true")
parser.add_argument("--proof", type=Path, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
assert platform.system() == "Linux" and platform.machine() == "x86_64"
args.proof.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
process_log = args.proof.with_suffix(".processes.jsonl")

def run(command, cwd, expected=0, input_data=None, timeout=120):
    command = [str(x) for x in command]
    started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    child = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=cwd, stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                             stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                             start_new_session=True)
    cleanup = "process exited"
    try:
        out, err = child.communicate(input=input_data, timeout=timeout)
    except BaseException:
        os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        try:
            child.communicate(timeout=3)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            child.communicate()
        cleanup = "child process group terminated"
        raise
    finally:
        with process_log.open("a") as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps(dict(parentTaskId=os.environ.get("CLASSES_FAMILY_TASK_ID", "assembly-stack-native"),
                command=command, cwd=str(cwd), pid=child.pid, startTime=started,
                endTime=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                exitCode=child.returncode, timeoutSeconds=timeout,
                childProcessGroupCleanup=cleanup)) + "\n")
    assert (child.returncode != 0 if expected == "failure" else child.returncode == expected), (command, child.returncode, (out + err).decode(errors="replace"))
    return out, err

def hashes():
    return {str(f.relative_to(PACK)): hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            for f in PACK.rglob("*") if f.is_file()}

def signed(number):
    bits = number % (1 << 64)
    return bits - (1 << 64) if bits >= (1 << 63) else bits

def oracle(a, b):
    return signed((2 * a + 5) + (2 * b + 5))

inputs = [(0,0),(3,7),(-5,19),(-1,-1),((1<<63)-1,1),(-(1<<63),-1),
          (-(1<<63),(1<<63)-1),((1<<63)-1,(1<<63)-1),(-(1<<63),-(1<<63)),
          (1<<32,-7),(-7,1<<32),(41,-80)]
state = 0x312fa56c70b981d4
for _ in range(10000):
    state = (state * 6364136223846793005 + 1442695040888963407) % (1<<64)
    a = signed(state)
    state = (state * 6364136223846793005 + 1442695040888963407) % (1<<64)
    inputs.append((a,signed(state)))
assert len(inputs) == 10012
oracle_input = "".join(f"{a} {b} {oracle(a,b)}\n" for a,b in inputs).encode()
demo_pairs = [(3,7),(-5,19),((1<<63)-1,1),(-(1<<63),-1)]
expected_demo = "".join(f"a={a} b={b} result={oracle(a,b)}\n" for a,b in demo_pairs).encode()
expected_contract = b"stack cases passed: 10012\n"
before = hashes()
version = run([args.cc,"--version"],ROOT)[0].decode().splitlines()[0]
profiles, unfinished, regressions = [],[],[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="assembly-stack-") as work:
    temp = Path(work)
    for role in ["starter","solution"]:
        shutil.copytree(PACK / role,temp / role)
    shutil.copytree(temp / "starter",temp / "completed")
    routine = temp / "completed/routine.S"
    code = routine.read_text()
    old = """    /* TODO STACK_CALLS: call stack_leaf for a, then b; keep b and the first
       result across calls, align the call sites and restore all saved state. */
    xor eax, eax
    ret"""
    learner = """    push rbp
    push rbx
    push r12
    mov rbx, rsi
    call stack_leaf
    mov r12, rax
    mov rdi, rbx
    call stack_leaf
    add rax, r12
    pop r12
    pop rbx
    pop rbp
    ret"""
    assert code.count(old) == 1
    routine.write_text(code.replace(old,learner))
    for f in (temp / "starter").iterdir():
        if f.name != "routine.S":
            assert f.read_bytes() == (temp / "completed" / f.name).read_bytes()
    for role in ["starter","solution","completed"]:
        for profile in ["Debug","Release"]:
            build = temp / (role + "-" + profile)
            run(["cmake","-S",temp / role,"-B",build,"-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE="+profile,
                 "-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER="+args.cc,"-DCMAKE_ASM_COMPILER="+args.cc],temp)
            run(["cmake","--build",build,"--parallel","1"],temp)
            run(["ctest","--test-dir",build,"--output-on-failure"],temp,
                expected="failure" if role=="starter" else 0)
            output,error = run([build / "assembly_stack"],temp,expected=78 if role=="starter" else 0)
            direct,_ = run([build / "stack_contracts"],temp,expected=1 if role=="starter" else 0)
            independent,_ = run([build / "stack_contracts","--oracle"],temp,
                expected=1 if role=="starter" else 0,input_data=oracle_input)
            if role=="starter":
                assert not output and b"unfinished or incorrect" in error
                unfinished.append(dict(profile=profile,demoExit=78,contractExit=1))
            else:
                assert output==expected_demo and not error
                assert direct==independent==expected_contract
                profiles.append(dict(role=role,profile=profile,stackCases=10012,
                    independentPythonOracleCases=10012,preservedRegisters=6,
                    actualLeafCallsPerInvocation=2,orderedArgumentsVerified=True,
                    leafEntryStackRemainder=8,callerSavedRegistersClobbered=True,
                    demoOutput=output.decode()))
    reference = (temp / "solution/routine.S").read_text()
    begin = reference.index("stack_pair:\n") + len("stack_pair:\n")
    end = reference.index(".size stack_pair",begin)
    mutations = {
        "numeric-shortcut": reference[:begin]+"    lea rax, [rdi + rsi]\n    lea rax, [rax + rax + 10]\n    ret\n"+reference[end:],
        "wrong-second-argument": reference.replace("    mov rbx, rsi","    mov rbx, rdi"),
        "lost-first-result": reference.replace("    mov r12, rax","    mov r12, 0"),
        "stack-alignment": reference.replace("    sub rsp, 8","    sub rsp, 16").replace("    add rsp, 8","    add rsp, 16"),
        "preserved-register": reference.replace("    pop rbx","    add rsp, 8"),
        "result-width": reference.replace("    lea rax, [rdi + rdi + 5]","    lea eax, [rdi + rdi + 5]"),
        "wrong-leaf-offset": reference.replace("    lea rax, [rdi + rdi + 5]","    lea rax, [rdi + rdi + 6]")
    }
    for kind,mutant in mutations.items():
        assert mutant!=reference
        folder=temp/kind
        shutil.copytree(temp/"solution",folder)
        (folder/"routine.S").write_text(mutant)
        run([args.cc,"-std=c17","-O1","-Wall","-Wextra","-Wpedantic","-Wconversion","-Werror",
             "-DSTACK_TEST_PROBE","tests.c","abi_checks.S","routine.S","-o","broken"],folder)
        _,error=run([folder/"broken"],folder,expected="failure")
        if kind=="preserved-register":
            assert b"callee-saved register contract failed" in error
        regressions.append(dict(kind=kind,rejected=True))
    disassembly=run(["objdump","-d","-M","intel",temp/"solution-Debug/assembly_stack"],temp)[0]
    assert b"<stack_pair>:" in disassembly and b"<stack_leaf>:" in disassembly
    debugger=dict(status="not exercised in emulated local run")
    if not args.skip_debugger:
        trace,_=run(["gdb","--batch","--nx","-q",temp/"solution-Debug/assembly_stack",
            "-ex","set disassembly-flavor intel","-ex","tbreak *stack_leaf","-ex","run",
            "-ex",'printf "STACK-input=%lld\\n", $rdi',
            "-ex",'printf "STACK-entry-rem=%lu\\n", ((unsigned long)$rsp & 15)',
            "-ex","finish","-ex",'printf "STACK-leaf=%lld\\n", $rax',"-ex","continue"],temp)
        assert b"STACK-input=3" in trace and b"STACK-entry-rem=8" in trace and b"STACK-leaf=11" in trace
        assert b"a=3 b=7 result=30" in trace
        debugger=dict(status="accepted",trace=trace.decode())
assert not Path(work).exists() and before==hashes()
receipt=dict(event="verified-assembly-stack",compiler=args.cc,compilerVersion=version,
    acceptedProfiles=profiles,unfinishedProfilesRejected=unfinished,controlledRegressions=regressions,
    independentLearnerCompletedOnly="routine.S",independentOracle="Python arbitrary-precision arithmetic",
    debugger=debugger,sourceFilesUnchanged=True,temporaryBuildCleanup=True)
args.proof.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(dict(event=receipt["event"],compiler=args.cc,stackCases=sum(p["stackCases"] for p in profiles),
    acceptedProfiles=len(profiles),regressionsRejected=len(regressions),debugger=debugger["status"])))
